morphology.pattern_note: 依输入把 gemuruh 作为现代派生的基词，ge 读 /ɡə/。传统构词分析另有 guruh + 中缀 -em- → gemuruh；该中缀类型不在所给 affix_type 枚举中。[DBP《Morfologi》](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 声音强烈而轰隆作响的；如雷鸣般响亮的。
senses.en_definition: Loud and rumbling or roaring, like thunder.
senses.ms_definition: Kuat dan menderu-deru bunyinya seperti guruh.
senses.nuances: 常形容掌声、欢呼声、飞机或瀑布的声音；强调持续或滚动般的强大声势。表示发出这种声音的动作时常用 bergemuruh。[DBP：gemuruh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gemuruh)

senses.zh_definition: 因害怕、忧虑或面对重要场面而心跳加快、紧张不安的。
senses.en_definition: Nervous or apprehensive, especially with a pounding heart.
senses.ms_definition: Berdebar-debar hati kerana ketakutan atau kebimbangan; agak gementar.
senses.nuances: 常见于上台、面试和比赛前的紧张；不是医学诊断，也不必然达到恐慌的程度。[DBP：gemuruh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gemuruh)

dual_scenarios.ms: Para hadirin memberikan tepukan gemuruh selepas pembentangan itu selesai.
dual_scenarios.zh: 报告结束后，与会者报以雷鸣般的掌声。
dual_scenarios.en: The audience gave thunderous applause when the presentation ended.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 上台前向朋友倾诉
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah mula rasa gemuruh lah, kejap lagi nak naik pentas.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah mula berasa gemuruh kerana sebentar lagi saya akan naik ke pentas.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经开始紧张了啦，等一下就要上台。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm starting to get nervous. I'm going on stage in a minute.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式
kejap lagi 对应 sebentar lagi
nak 在此表示即将进行的行动

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku gemuruh lah. Ramai orang dah duduk kat depan pentas.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berasa gemuruh. Ramai orang sudah duduk di hadapan pentas.
messages.zh: 我好紧张啊，台前已经坐了好多人。
messages.en: I'm so nervous. There are already loads of people sitting in front of the stage.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tarik nafas dulu. Cakap perlahan je, kau dah berlatih banyak kali.
messages.ms_standard: Tarik nafas dahulu. Bercakaplah dengan perlahan; kamu sudah berlatih banyak kali.
messages.zh: 先深呼吸。慢慢说就好，你都练过好多次了。
messages.en: Take a breath first. Just speak slowly. You've practised plenty of times.

etymology.historical_story: DBP's morphology reference presents gemuruh as guruh, meaning thunder, with the infix -em-. The word offers a vivid bridge between the outside world and inner experience: a crowd can sound thunderous, while someone awaiting a public appearance can feel a similarly overwhelming disturbance within. Both meanings are recorded in Kamus Dewan. [DBP《Morfologi》](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf)；[DBP 词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gemuruh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 guruh＝雷：外面雷声轰隆，是 gemuruh；心里像打雷一样怦怦跳，也是 gemuruh。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 形容掌声时通常带赞赏意味。别人说自己 gemuruh，宜给予安慰；不要用来公开嘲笑对方怯场。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于新闻、舞台活动和日常谈心。正式场合描述个人状态，可说 berasa gemuruh；描述现场声势，可说 tepukan gemuruh。
